name: Tzatziki-Dressed Salad with Chickpeas, Pita Chips, Olives & Feta
instructions: Place pitas on a flat surface. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into 2-inch pieces and transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Drizzle pita with oil and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until the pita chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place tzatziki, vinegar, oil, and salt in a large bowl. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl, along with the pita chips and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
